UUID_purpose: Factory-default beacon identity broadcast by EM's Bluetooth Low Energy proximity beacon modules (EMBC22, EMBP01 and siblings) when the operator leaves the identity parameter at 0 in the Beacon Configuration Tool Suite: it is used both as the iBeacon proximity UUID and as the AltBeacon GUID, and its first 10 bytes (699e-bc80-e1f3-11e3-9a0f) are the default Eddystone-UID Namespace. A device advertising this value has not had its beacon identity customized; its Major/Minor IDs (or Eddystone UID Instance) are then derived from the device address instead. This is an RFC 4122 v1 (time-based) UUID whose node field 0c:f3:ee:3b:c0:12 embeds EM Microelectronic's IEEE OUI 0C:F3:EE, which is also the OUI of the modules' factory-assigned Bluetooth device addresses. Carried in non-connectable undirected advertising (ADV_NONCONN_IND) inside Manufacturer Specific Data, so it is not exposed as a GATT Service UUID.

evidence_array.description: EMBC22 datasheet (EMBC22-DS, Version 6.0, 29-Sep-21), section 6.2.5: 'If the UUID is set to 0, the default UUID of 699EBC80-E1F3-11E3-9A0F-0CF3EE3BC012 is used' (iBeacon), the same value again as the default AltBeacon GUID, and 'the default UID Namespace value is 699E-BC80-E1F3-11E3-9A0F' (Eddystone). Section 6.2.5 also states these packet types are ADV_NONCONN_IND.

EMBP01 datasheet (EMBP01-DS, Version 3.0), section 6.2.5, repeats the identical default iBeacon UUID, AltBeacon GUID and Eddystone UID Namespace, and gives the worked example device address 0C:F3:EE:AA:BB:CC, confirming the 0C:F3:EE prefix of EM beacon addresses.
IEEE OUI registry: 0C-F3-EE is assigned to 'EM Microelectronic'. That OUI is the trailing 3 bytes of this UUIDv1's node field, independently corroborating EM as the generator of this UUID.
